English: Pooled estimates from meta-analysis indicate during COVID-19 measures, 32.3% (95% CI 23.9-42.1) of people needing HIV/STI testing had hindered access, 4.4% (95% CI 3.4-5.4) experienced partner violence, and 5.8% (95% CI 5.4-8.2) decreased casual partner condom use (moderate certainty of evidence for each outcome).
Luganda: Okugeraageranya okwawamu okuva mu kwekaliriza kulaga nti mu kiseera ky’okukugirwa olwa COVID-19 abantu 32.3% (95% CI 23.9-42.1) abaali beetaaga okwekebeza HIV/STI baakugirwa, abantu 4.4% (95% CI 3.4-5.4) baayita mu bukwambwe okuva eri abaagalwa baabwe, ne 5.8% (95% CI 5.4-8.2) baakendeeza ku kukozesa kwa kondomu eri abaagalwa abatali balubeerera (ebiraga okwekakasa okusaamusaamu ku buli kyazuulibwa).
Yoruba: Àwọn ìṣirò tí a fàyọ lásìkò àyẹ̀wò àṣekiri fi hàn pé lásìkò òfin ààrùn COVID-19, 32.3% (95% CI 23.9-42.1) àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n nílò àyẹ̀wò HIV/STI ni ò ṣe ìdíwọ́ fún níní àǹfààní, 4.4% (95% CI 3.4-5.4) ní ìrrírí ìwà-ipá àtọ̀dọ̀ alábàaárìn 5.8% (95% CI 5.4-8.2) sì mú àdínkù bá ìlò rọ́bà ìdáàbòbọ̀ alábàárìn wọn. (ìdánilójú ẹ̀rí tó ṣe rẹ́gí fún àwọn àbájáde kọ̀ọ̀kan).
Zulu: Izilinganiso ezihlanganisiwe ezivela kwi-meta-analysisa zikhomba ngesikhathi sezinyathelo se-COVID-19, ama-32.3% (95% CI 23.9-42.1) wabantu abadinga ukuhlolelwa i-HIV/STI bavimbe ukufinyelela, ama-4.4% (95% CI 3.4-5.4) waba nodlame lozakwethu, kanye nesi-5.8% (95% CI 5.4-8.2) yehlise ukusetshenziswa kwejazi lomkhwenyana kozakwethu nje (ukuqiniseka okusesilinganisweni kobufakazi kumphumela ngamunye).
Hausa: Ƙididdiga ƙima daga masu nazarin wasu bayanai suna nuna a yayin matakan cutar COVID-19, kashi 32.3% (95% CI 23.9-42.1) na mutanen da suke buƙatar gwajin HIV/STI ba su sami shiga ba, kashi 4.4% (95% CI 3.4-5.4) sun fuskanci tashin hankalin abokin tarayya, kuma kashi 5.8% (95% CI 5.4-8.2) sun rage amfani da kwaroron roba na abokin tarayya na yau da kullum (matsakaicin tabbacin shaida ga kowane sakamako).
Northern Sotho: Dikakanyo tše di hweditšwego go tšwa tshekatsheko ye kgolo di laedtša gore ka nakong ya magato a COVID-19, 32.3% (95% CI 23.9-42.1) ya batho bao ba hlokago teko ya HIV/STI e paledišitše phihlelelo, 4.4% (95% CI 3.4-5.4) e itemogetše dikgaruru tša balekane, mola 5.8% (95% CI 5.4-8.2) e fokoditše tšhomišo ya dikhontomo ya thobalano le molekane wa setlwaedi (go ba le bonnete ga magareng ga bohlatse bja poelo ye nngwe le ye nngwe).
Amharic: ከሜታ-ትንታኔ የተዋጡ ግምቶች በኮቪድ-19 እርምጃዎች፣ 32.3% (95% CI 23.9-42.1) የኤችአይቪ/STI ምርመራ ከሚያስፈልጋቸው ሰዎች ተደራሽነት እንቅፋት እንደነበረባቸው፣ 4.4% (95% CI 3.4-5.4) የአጋር ጥቃት አጋጥሟቸዋል፣ እና 5.8% (95% CI 5.4-8.2) የተራ አጋር ኮንዶም አጠቃቀም ቀንሷል (ለእያንዳንዱ ውጤት መጠነኛ የሆነ የማስረጃ እርግጠኝነት)።

Zulu: Baphinde baxwayisa ngokuthi udlame lezocansi lungakhula njengoba umhlaba uvela kule mpathamhlaba, nokuthi ukuqapha kubalulekile ezifundeni lapho izinhlelo zezempilo sezivele zinengcindezi, njenge-Afrika.

Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lemoša gape gore dikgaruru tša thobalano di ka oketša ge lefase le etšwa go leuba le, le gore go hlokomedišiša go bohlokwa ka dileteng fao mananeo a maphelo a tlogago a le ka fase ga kgatelelo, go swnaa le ka Afrika.
Amharic: ዓለም ከወረርሽኙ ሲወጣ ጾታዊ ጥቃት ሊጨምር እንደሚችል፣ እና እንደ አፍሪካ ያሉ መጀመሪያም ጫና ያለባቸው የጤና ስርአቶች ባሉባቸው ክልሎች ውስጥ ቁጥጥር ወሳኝ ነው ሲሉም አስጠንቅቀዋል።

English: Billions of people globally needed to quarantine to stay safe.
Luganda: Abantu buwumbi na buwumbi mu nsi yonna baalina okuteekwa mu kalantiini olw’okwetaasa ekirwadde.
Yoruba: Ọgunlọ́gọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn káàkiri àgbááyé ni wọ́n nílò láti wà ní ìyàsọ́tọ̀ láti wà lálàáfíà.
Zulu: Izigidigidi zabantu emhlabeni wonke zidinga ukuvalelwa zodwa ukuze zihlale ziphephile.
Hausa: Biliyoyin mutane a duniya suna buƙatar keɓe domin kasancewa cikin aminci.
Northern Sotho: Duipilione tša batho l;efaseng ka bphara di hloka go beelwa thoko gore ba dule ba phetše gabotse.
Amharic: በዓለም ዙሪያ በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደህንነታቸውን ለመጠበቅ ውሸባ ያስፈልጋቸዋል።

English: Researchers suspected the quarantines in the first wave of the pandemic changed many people's social and sexual behaviour, and impacted their sexual and reproductive health (SRH).
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateebereza nti kalantiini mu lulumba olwasooka olwa nawookeera yakyusa enneeyisa y’abantu mu bykwegatta mu byomukwano, era ne kikosa ebyobulamu bwabwe mu byokwegatta ne mu byokuzaala (SRH).
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí kẹ́fín pé ìyàsọ́tọ̀ ní àsìkò ìjì àkọ́kọ́ yí ìṣesí àwùjọ àti ìbálòpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ padà, ó sì nípa lórí ìlera ìbálòpọ̀ àti ìbísí (SRH) wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basola ukuthi ukuvalelwa kwabantu egagasi lokuqala yale mpathamhlaba kwashintsha indlela abantu abaningi abaziphatha ngayo kwezenhlalo nezocansi, futhi kwaba nomthelela empilweni yabo yezocansi kanye nokuzala (SRH).
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi zargin keɓe a guguwar farko ta annobar ta canza yanayin zamantakewa da ɗabi’ar jima'i na mutane da yawa, kuma ta yi tasiri a lafiyar jima'i da haihuwarsu (SRH).
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba belaela gore go beela batho thoko ka lephotong la mathomo la leuba le go ile gwa fetoša maitshwaro a batho ba bantši mabapi le tša leago le thobalano, gomme se se ile sa ama maphelo a bona a tša thobalano le a pelego (SRH).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በወረርሽኙ የመጀመሪያ ማዕበል ውስጥ የተደረጉት ውሸባዎች የብዙ ሰዎችን ማህበራዊ እና ጾታዊ ባህሪ ቀይሮ፣ እና በጾታዊ እና ስነ ተዋልዶ ጤና (SRH) ላይ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል።

English: In this study they aimed to find out exactly how this changed.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno baaluubirira okuzuula ekyo engeri kino kyennyini bwe kyajja.
Yoruba: Ní inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí wọ́n gbérò láti mọ̀ ní pàtó bí èyí ṣe ń yí padà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo babehlose ukuthola ukuthi lokhu kwashintsha kanjani.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken sun yi nufin gano ainihin yadda abin ya canza.
Northern Sotho: Inka mo dinyakišišong tše ba ile ba ikemišetša go tseba gabotse gore se se fetogile bjang.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ ይህ በትክክል እንዴት እንደተቀየረ ለማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: Researchers specifically wanted to know if people changed their sexual behaviours, such as condom use or how often they had sex.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya oba ng’abantu baakyusa empisa zaabwe mu byokwegatta, gamba ng’okukozesa kondomu oba emirundi gye beegattanga.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ kanlẹ̀ mọ̀ bóyá àwọn ènìyàn máa ń yí ìṣesí ìbálòpọ̀ wọn padà, bíi ìlò rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò tàbí bí wọ́n ṣe ń ní ìbálòpọ̀ sí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi ngokukhethekile babefuna ukwazi ukuthi abantu bazishintshile yini izenzo zabo zocansi, njengokusebenzisa ijazi lomkhwenyana noma ukuthi baya ocansini kangaki.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun so su san ko mutane sun canza ɗabi'ar jima'i, kamar amfani da kwaroron roba ko sau nawa suka yi jima'i.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba tloga ba nyala go tseba ge eba batho ba ile ba fetoša maitshwaro a bona atša thobalano, a go swaa le go šomiša dikhontomo goba le gore ba tsenela thobalano gakae.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በተለይ ሰዎች እንደ ኮንዶም አጠቃቀም ወይም ምን ያህል ጊዜ ወሲብ እንደሚፈጽሙ ያሉ፣ ወሲባዊ ባህሪያቸውን ለውጠው እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ፈልገዋል።

English: They also wanted to know if people experienced more or less violence from their intimate partner.
Luganda: Era baayagala okumanya oba ng’abantu baafuna obukambwe obusingako oba butonoko okuva mu baagalwa baabwe be beegatta nabo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fẹ́ mọ̀ bóyá àwọn ènìyàn ń ní álékún tàbí àdínkù ìrírí ìwà-ipá láti ọ̀dọ̀ alábàárìn tí ó súnmọ́ wọn pẹ́kí.
Zulu: Baphinde bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ingabe abantu bake babhekana nobudlova obuningi noma obuncane obuvela kubalingani babo abasondelene nabo.
Hausa: Sun kuma so su san ko mutane sun sami ƙarin ko ragin tashin hankali daga abokin tarayya na ƙud-da-ƙud.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge eba batho ba ile ba itemogela dikgaruru tše ntši goba tše mmalwa go tšwa go balekane ba bona ba thobalano.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ሰዎች ከቅርብ አጋራቸው ብዙ ወይም ያነሰ ጥቃት ደርሶባቸው እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: Lastly, they wanted to know if people changed how they used or were able to access SRH services, such as abortion facilities and testing for sexually transmitted infections (STIs).
Luganda: Ekisembayo, baayagala okumanya oba ng’abantu baakozesa oba nga baasobolanga okufuna empeereza ya SRH, gamba ng’okuggyamu embuto n’okwekebeza endwadde z’ekikaba (STIs).
Yoruba: Ní ìpari, wọ́n fẹ́ mọ̀ bóyá àwọn ènìyàn máa ń mú àyípadà bá bí wọ́n ṣe ń lò tàbí ní àǹfààní sí àwọn ètò SHR, bíi àwọn ohun èlò ìṣẹ́yún àti àyẹ̀wò lọ́wọ́ àwọn ààrùn tí ó ń bá ìbálòpọ̀ rìn (STIs).
Zulu: Okokugcina, babefuna ukwazi ukuthi ingabe abantu bashintshe indlela abasebenzisa ngayo noma bakwazi ukuthola izinsiza ze-SRH, ezifana nezindawo zokuhushula izisu kanye nokuhlolelwa izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi (STIs).
Hausa: A ƙarshe, suna so su san ko mutane sun canza yadda suke amfani da su ko kuma sun sami damar yin amfani da ayyuka na SRH, kamar wuraren zubar da ciki da gwajin cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs).
Northern Sotho: Sa mafelelo, ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge eba batho ba ile ba fetoša ka fao ba bego ba šomiša goba ba be ba kgona go fihlelela ditirelo tša SRH, tša go swana le mafelo a go ntšha dimpa le go dira diteko tša malwetši a thobalano (di-STI).
Amharic: በመጨረሻም፣ ሰዎች እንዴት እንደሚጠቀሙባቸው ወይም እንደ ውርጃ ማድረጊያ ተቋማት እና በግብረ ሥጋ ግንኙነት የሚተላለፉ ኢንፌክሽኖች (STIs) ምርመራ፣ ያሉ የSRH አገልግሎቶችን እንዴት እንደሚጠቀሙ ወይም ማግኘት እንደቻሉ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: The researchers did an online survey to gather information about how the first COVID-19 wave affected people's sexual lives.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano baabuuza ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano okukuŋŋaanya obubaka obukwata ku lulumba lwa COVID-19 n’engeri gye lwakosaamu enneeyisa y’abantu mu byokwegatta mu byomukwano.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìtọpinpin orí ẹ̀rọ láti kó àlàyé jọ nípa bí ìjì COVID-19 àkọ́kọ́ ṣe nípa lórí ayé àwọn ènìyàn lábala ìbálòpọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benze inhlolovo eku-inthanethi ukuze baqoqe imininingwane yokuthi igagasi lokuqala le-COVID-19 liyithinte kanjani impilo yabantu kwezocansi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi wani binciken kan intanet don tattara bayanai game da yadda guguwar farko ta annobar COVID-19 ta shafi rayuwar mutane ta jima'i.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba dira dinyakišišo tša inthaneteng go kgoboketša tshedimošo ka ga ka fao lephoto la mathomo la COVID-19 le ilego la ama maphelo a thobalano a batho.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የመጀመሪያው የኮቪድ-19 ማዕበል በሰዎች ወሲባዊ ሕይወቶች ላይ እንዴት ተጽዕኖን እንዳሳደረ መረጃን ለመሰብሰብ የመስመር ላይ የዳሰሳ ጥናት አድርገዋል።

English: Almost 23 000 people from 30 countries participated in the survey.
Luganda: Kumpi abantu 23 000 ouva mu nsi 30 beetaba mu kubuuzibwa.
Yoruba: Ó fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ tó 23 000 a[wọn ènìyàn láti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè 30 ni wọ́n kópa nínú ìtọpinpin náà.
Zulu: Balinganiselwa kwizi-23 000 abantu abavela emazweni angama-30 ababambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo.
Hausa: Kusan mutane guda 23 000 daga ƙasashe 30 ne suka shiga binciken.
Northern Sotho: Batho bao ba nyakilego go ba ba 23 000 go tšwa ka dinageng tše 30 ba ile ba kgatha tema ka dinyakišišong.
Amharic: በዳሰሳ ጥናቱ ከ30 ሃገራት ወደ 23 000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ተሳትፈዋል።

English: Of these, 4 countries were in Africa, 11 countries were in Europe, 6 in the Americas, and 4 in Asia and Oceania.
Luganda: Ku abo, ensi 4 zaali mu Afirika, 11 mu Bulaya, 6 mu Amerika, ne 4 mu Asia ne Oceania.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn wọ̀nyìí, orílẹ̀-èdè 4 wà ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà, orílẹ̀-èdè 11 wà ní ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù, 6 ní Amẹ́ríkà àti 4 ni Ésíà àti ní Òṣánníà.
Zulu: Kulawa, ma-4 amazwe ase-Afrika, ali-11 ase-Europr, ayi-6 emazweni aseMelika, ma-4 e-Asia nase-Oceania.
Hausa: Daga cikin waɗannan ƙasashe guda 4 sun kasance a Afirka, kasashe 11 a Turai, 6 a Amurka, 4 a Asiya da kuma Oceania.
Northern Sotho: Go tšona, dinaga tše 4 di be di etšw aka Afrika, dinaga tše 11 di be di etšwa ka Yuropa, tše 6 ka Amerika, gomme tše 4 ka Asia le Oceania.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ፣ 4 አገራት ከአፍሪካ፣ 11 ከአውሮፓ፣ 6ቱ በአሜሪካዎች፣ እና 4ቱ በእስያ እና በኦሺኒያ ነበሩ።

English: The survey asked various questions about sexuality, gender identity, sexual behaviour, abortion, and violence from an intimate partner.
Luganda: Ebibuuzo byali bikwata ku bibuuzo eby’enjawulo ku kikula, ekikula omuntu kye yeekwanya nakyo, empisa mu byokwegatta, okuggyamu embuto, n’obukambwe okuva eri omwagalwa w’omuntu bwe beegatta mu byomukwano.
Yoruba: Ìtọpinpin yìí bèrè onírúurú àwọn ìbéèrè nípa ìbálòpọ̀, ẹ̀yà ìbí, ìṣesí ìbálòpọ̀, oyún ṣíṣẹ́ àti ìwà-ipá láti ọ̀dọ̀ alábàárìn tí o súnmọ́ni pékí.
Zulu: Lenhlolovo ibuze imibuzo eyahlukene mayelana nocansi, ukuhlukanisa ubulili, ukuziphatha kocansi, ukuhushula isisu, nodlame oluvela kumuntu osondelene naye.
Hausa: Binciken ya yi tambayoyi daban-daban game da jima'i da asalin jinsi da halayen jima’i da zubar da ciki da tashin hankali daga abokin tarayya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di botšišitše dipotšišo tše di fapafapanego ka ga bong, boitšhupo bja bong, maitshwaro a thobalano, go ntšha mpa, le dikgaruru go tšwa go molekane wa tša thobalano.
Amharic: የዳሰሳ ጥናቱ ስለ ወሲባዊነት፣ የፆታ ማንነት፣ ወሲባዊ ባህሪ፣ ፅንስ ማስወረድ፣ እና ከቅርብ ጓደኛ የሚደረስ ጥቃትን በተመለከተ የተለያዩ ጥያቄዎችን ጠይቋል።

English: The survey showed that condom use stayed the same for about 74% of people and decreased for about 14% of people.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwalaga nti okukozesa kondomu tekwakyuka era kwali ku bitundu by’abantu 74% ate ne kukka okutuuka ku bitundu by’abantu 14%.
Yoruba: Ìtọpinpin náà fi hàn pé ìlò rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò wà bẹ́ẹ̀ fún bíi 74% àwọn ènìyàn ó sì dínkù nínú bíi 14% àwọn ènìyàn.
Zulu: Inhlolovo ibonise ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwejazi lomkhwenyana akushintshile kubantu abangaba ngama-74% futhi kwehle cishe nge-14% wabantu.
Hausa: Binciken ya nuna cewa amfani da kwaroron roba ya kasance iri ɗaya ga kusan kashi 74% na mutane kuma ya ragu da kusan kashi 14% na mutane.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di aleditše gore tšhomišo ya dikhontomo e no dula e swana go batho bao ba ka bago 74% gomme yona e ile ya fokotšega go batho bao ba 14%.
Amharic: የዳሰሳ ጥናቱ እንደሚያሳየው የኮንዶም አጠቃቀም ለ74% ሰዎች ተመሳሳይ ሆኖ ሲቀጠል እና ለ14% ሰዎች ቀንሷል።

English: It also showed that sexual violence slightly declined from 7% to 9%.
Luganda: Era kwalaga nti obukambwe mu byokwegatta mu byomukwano kwakkamu katono okuva ku bitundu 7% okutuuka ku 9%.
Yoruba: Ó tún fi hàn pé ìwà-ipá ìbálòpọ̀ dínkù díẹ láti 7% sí 9%.
Zulu: Kuphinde kwakhombisa ukuthi udlame locansi lwehle kancane lusuka kwi-7% lwaya kwi-9%.
Hausa: Haka nan ya nuna cewa cin zarafi na jima'i ya ɗan ragu daga kashi 7% zuwa kashi 9%.
Northern Sotho: E bontšhitše gape gore dikgaruru tša thobalano di ile tša theogela fase gannyane go tloga go 7% go fihla go 9%.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ወሲባዊ ጥቃት በትንሹ ከ7% ወደ 9% መቀነሱን ያሳያል።

English: It was also clear that COVID-19 prevention made it difficult to access sexual health services.
Luganda: Era kyali kyeraga bulungi nti okutangira COVID-19 kwakifuula kizubu okufuna obuweereza bw’empeereza y’ebyokwegatta mu byomukwano.
Yoruba: Ó tún hàn gbangba pé ìdèènà COVID-19 jẹ́ kí ó nira láti ní àǹfààní sí àwọn ètò ìlera ìbálòpọ̀.
Zulu: Kuphinde kwacaca ukuthi ukuvikela i-COVID-19 kwenza kwaba nzima ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo zocansi.
Hausa: Haka nan a bayyane yake cewa rigakafin cutar COVID-19 ya sa ya yi wahala samun dama ga ayyuka na lafiyar jima’i.
Northern Sotho: Gape go be go le molaleng gore thobelo ya COVID-19 e dirile gore go be boima go fihlelela ditirelo tša maphelo a thobalano.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የኮቪድ-19 መከላከል የወሲባዊ ጤና አገልግሎቶችን ማግኘት አስቸጋሪ እንዳደረገው ግልጽ ነበር።

English: For example, 9% of people could not access condoms, 8% could not access contraceptives, and 31% could not be tested for STIs.
Luganda: Okugeza, abantu 9% baali tebasobola kufuna kondomu, 8% baali tebasobola kufuna nkola za kwegema mbuto, ne 31% baali tebasobola kwekebeza STIs.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, 9% àwọn ènìyàn kò ní àǹfààní sí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò, 8% kò ní àǹfààní sí àwọn oògùn adènà oyún, nígbà tí 31% kò ní àǹfààní sí àyẹ̀wò àwọn STIs.
Zulu: Isibonelo, abantu abayisi-9% abakwazanga ukuthola amajazi omkhwenyana, abayisi-8% abakwazanga ukuthola izinto zokuvimbela inzalo, kanti abangama-31% abakwazanga ukuhlolelwa izifo zocansi.
Hausa: Alal misali, kashi 9% na mutane ba za su iya samun kwaroron roba ba, kashi 8% ba za su iya samun rigakafin hana haihuwa ba, kuma kashi 31% ba za a iya gwada su domin cututtukan STIs ba.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, 9% ya batho ba paletšwe ke go fihlelela dikhontomo, 8% e paletšwe ke go fihlelea dithibelapelego, gomme 31% e paletšwe ke go dirwa diteko tša di-STI.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ 9% ሰዎች ኮንዶም ማግኘት አልቻሉም፣ 8% የወሊድ መከላከያዎችን መጠቀም አልቻሉም፣ እና 31% የሚሆኑት የአባላዘር በሽታዎች ምርመራን ማድረግ አልቻሉም።

English: Nearly 31% of people who needed abortion services were prevented or hindered.
Luganda: Kumpi abantu 31% abaali baagala okuggyamu embuto baaziyizibwa era ne bakugirwa.
Yoruba: Ó fẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́ tó 31% àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n nílò oyún ṣíṣẹ́ ni wọ́n dèènà tàbí dínà mọ́.
Zulu: Cishe ama-31% abantu ababedinga izinsiza zokuhushula izisu bavinjelwa noma bavinjwa.
Hausa: Kusan kashi 31% na mutanen da suke buƙatar ayyuka na zubar da ciki an hana su.
Northern Sotho: Palo ye e nyakilego go ba 31% ya batho bao ba bego ba nyakago go ntšha dimpa ba ile ba thibelwa goba ba paledišwa.
Amharic: የውርጃ አገልግሎት ከሚያስፈልጋቸው ሰዎች 31% የሚጠጉት ተከልክለዋል ወይም ተስተጓጉለዋል።

English: This study confirmed that sexual health and behaviour changed during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakakasa nti ebyokwegatta mu byomukwano n’empisa byakyuka mu lulumba lwa COVID-19 olwasooka.
Yoruba: Ịṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé ìlera ìbálòpọ̀ àti ìṣesí yípadà lásìkò ìjì COVID-19 àkọ́kọ́.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luqinisekisile ukuthi impilo nokuziphatha kwezocansi kwashintsha phakathi negagasi lokuqala lwempathamhlaba ye-COVID-19.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya tabbatar da cewa lafiyar jima'i da halayen jima’i sun canza a yayin guguwar farko ta annobar ta COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di tiišeditše gore maphelo a thobalano le maisthwaro a ile a fetoga ka nakong ya lephoto la mathomo la leuba la COVID-19.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ የመጀመሪያ ማዕበል ወቅት የወሲባዊ ጤና እና ባህሪ መለወጡን አረጋግጧል።

English: This suggests that healthcare authorities need to plan for ways to serve people better in future emergencies.
Luganda: Kino kiraga nti aboobuyinza mu bobulamu balina okuteekateeka engeri z’okuweereza abantu mu ngeri esingako obulungi gye bujja mu biseera by’akazigizigi.
Yoruba: Èyí dá a lábàá pé àwọn aláṣẹ ètò ìlera ní láti ṣeètò ọ̀nà láti tẹ́ àwọn ènìyàn lọ́rùn dáadáa síi ní àsìkò àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ pàjáwìrì ọjọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Lokhu kuphakamisa ukuthi iziphathimandla zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kudingeka zihlele izindlela zokusebenzela abantu kangcono ezimweni eziphuthumayo zesikhathi esizayo.
Hausa: Wannan yana nuna cewa hukumomin kiwon lafiya suna buƙatar tsara hanyoyin da za su yi wa mutane hidima mafi kyau a cikin gaggawa na gaba.
Northern Sotho: Se se šišinya gore ba taolo ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo ba swanetše go beakanyetša ditsela tša go direla batho bokaone ka maemong a tšhoganetšo a ka moso.
Amharic: ይህ የጤና እንክብካቤ ባለስልጣናት በወደፊት ድንገተኛ ሁኔታዎች ውስጥ ሰዎችን በተሻለ መንገድ ለማገልገል መንገዶችን ማቀድ እንዳለባቸው ይጠቁማል።

English: The researchers suggested implementing telemedicine and self-testing services.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateesa nti ku nkola y’okujjanjabira ku mutimbagano n’obuweereza bw’okwekebeza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí dábàá ìṣàmúlò iṣẹ́ ìwòsàn orí-aago àti ètò àyẹ̀wò ara ẹni.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphakamise ukusebenzisa i-telemedicine kanye nezinsiza zokuzihlola.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar aiwatar da ayyuka na magani daga nesa da kuma gwajin kai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba šišinya gore go dirišwe ditirelo tša dihlare ka megala le tša go itra diteko.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የርቀት ህክምና እና ራስን የመመርመር አገልግሎቶችን ተግባራዊ ስለማድረግ ሀሳብ አቅርበዋል።

English: They also showed that online global collaborations like this study are a viable option for future research.
Luganda: Era baalaga nti enkolagana z’oku mutimbagano ng’okunoonyereza kuno bwe kuli busobola okukozesebwa mu kunoonyereza okw’omu maaso.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fi hàn pé àwọn àjọṣepọ̀ àgbááyé orí-ẹ̀rọ bí irú èyí jẹ́ ohun èlò pàtàkì fún ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Baphinde babonisa ukuthi ukusebenzisana komhlaba wonke okuku-inthanethi njengalolu cwaningo kuyinketho esebenzayo yocwaningo lwangomuso.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun nuna cewa haɗin gwiwar duniya ta kan intanet kamar wannan binciken wani zaɓi ne mai dacewa don bincike na gaba.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba bontšha gape gore ditirišano tša inthaneteng tša lefase ka bophara tša go swana le dinyakišišo tše ke kgetho ye bohlokwa ya dinyakišišo tša ka moso.
Amharic: እንደዚኛው ጥናት ያሉ የመስመር ላይ አለምአቀፍ ትብብሮች ለወደፊት ምርምር ሥራ ላይ ሊውል የሚችል አማራጭ መሆኑንም አሳይተዋል።

English: They further emphasised that, once the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic have significantly reduced, researchers must look again at violence from intimate partners.
Luganda: Era baayongera ne bakkaatiriza nti okukosebwa kwa COVID-19 bwe kunaakendeerera ddala, abanoonyereza balina okuddamu ne bekkaanya ensonga y’obukambwe bw’abaagalwa ba bantu bwe beegatta nabo.
Yoruba: Wọn tẹ̀síwájú láti tẹnu mọ́ ọn pé, lógán tí ipa àjàkálẹ̀ ààrun COVID-19 bá ti dínkù, àwọn aṣèwádìí gbọdọ̀ wo ìwà ipá láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn alábàárìn lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi.
Zulu: Baphinde bagcizelela ukuthi, uma imiphumela yempathamhlaba ye-COVID-19 isinciphe kakhulu, abacwaningi kumele baphinde babheke udlame oluvela kubalingani abasondelene nabo.
Hausa: Sun kuma jaddada cewa, da zarar tasirin cutar ta COVID-19 ya ragu sosai, masu bincike dole ne su sake duba tashin hankali daga abokan tarayya na ƙud-da-ƙud.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba tšwela pele go gatelela gore, ge diabe tša leuba la COVID-19 di fokotšegile kudu, banyakišiši ba swanetše go lebelela gape dikgaruru go tšwa go balekane ba tša thobalano.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ መዘዞች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ከቀነሱ፣ ተመራማሪዎች ከቅርብ አጋሮች የሚመጡትን ጥቃቶች እንደገና መመልከት እንዳለባቸው አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።

English: This is because previous studies suggested that this tends to increase more drastically after an emergency than during one.
Luganda: Kino kiri kityo lwansonga nti okunoonyereza okw’emabega kwateesa nti kino kirabika okweyongerera ddala oluvannyuma lw’akaseera k’akazigizigi okusinga nga tewali.
Yoruba: Ìdí ni pé àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí àtẹ̀yìnwá dáa lábàá pé èyí fẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́ pọ̀ si gidi gan-an níye lẹ́yìn  ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ pàjáwìrì kan ju àsìkò ìkan lọ.
Zulu: Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izincwaningo zangaphambilini zaphakamisa ukuthi lokhu kuvame ukwanda kakhulu ngemva kwezimo eziphuthumayo kunangesikhathi esisodwa.
Hausa: Wannan shi ne saboda binciken da aka yi a baya ya nuna cewa wannan yana ƙaruwa sosai bayan gaggawa fiye da lokacin dɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Se ke ka lebaka la gore dinyakišišo tše di fetilego di šišintše gore se se fela se opketšega kudu ka morago ga maemo a tšhoganetšo go feta ka nakong ya ona.
Amharic: ምክንያቱም ከዚህ በፊት የተደረጉ ጥናቶች ይህ ከአደጋ ጊዜ በኋላ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ እንደሚሄድ ጠቁመዋል።

English: Previous studies also focused on high-income countries.
Luganda: Era okunoonyereza okwaggwa kwatunuulira amawanga agaakula edda.
Yoruba: Àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí àtẹ̀yìnwá bákan náà fojú sun àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìpawówọle pọ̀ níye.
Zulu: Izincwaningo zangaphambilini nazo zazigxile emazweni anemali engenayo ephezulu.
Hausa: Nazari na baya sun kuma mayar da hankali ne a kan ƙasashe masu tattalin arziki.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di fetilego di lebeletše gape dinaga tša letseno la godimo.
Amharic: ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ጥናቶችም ከፍተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው አገሮች ላይ ያተኮሩ ነበሩ።

English: These researchers did study some low- and middle-income countries, but they say more work is needed to include these countries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baatunuulira amawanga agamu agakyakula n’agaakulamu, naye baalaba nti bingi ebyetaaga okukolebwa okussa amawanga ago mu kunoonyereza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wádìí àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìpawówọlé wọn kéré àti àwọn tí ó wà ní agbedeméjì, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n sọ pé àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣì nílò láti ṣe àfikún àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè wọ̀nyìí.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bacwaninge amazwe anemali ephansi nephakathi, kodwa bathi kudingeka umsebenzi omningi ukuze kufakwe la mazwe.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun yi nazarin wasu ƙasashe masu ƙanana da matsakaitan kuɗaɗen shiga, amma sun ce ana buƙatar ƙarin aiki domin haɗa waɗannan kasashe.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba ile ba nyakišiša ka ga dinaga tša letseno la fase le tša letseno la magareng, eupša ba bolela gore go hlokega mošomo o montši go akaretša dinaga tše.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች አንዳንድ ዝቅተኛ- እና መካከለኛ- ገቢ ያላቸውን አገሮች ያጠኑ ቢሆንም፣ እነዚህን አገሮች ለማካተት ተጨማሪ ሥራ እንደሚያስፈልግ ይናገራሉ።

English: The researchers cautioned that their results might not apply to everyone.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baalabula nti bye baazuula biyinza obutakwata ku buli muntu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wọ̀nyìí ṣèkìlọ̀ pé àwọn èsì wọn lè má bá gbogbo ènìyàn wí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayise ngokuthi imiphumela yabo ingase ingasebenzi kuwo wonke umuntu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa wataƙila sakamakonsu ba zai shafi kowa ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba eletša gore dipoelo tša bona di ka nos e direge go mang le mang.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ውጤቶቻቸው ለሁሉም ላይሆኑ እንደሚችሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።

English: For example, the majority of the people who answered their survey questions were women and people from rich countries.
Luganda: Okugeza, abantu abasinga abaayanukula ebibuuzo byabwe baali bakyala ate nga bava mu mawanga agaakula edda.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, púpọ̀ nìnú àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n dáhùn àwọn ìbéèrè ìtọpinpin náà jẹ́ obìnrin wọ́n sì wá láti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó lówó.
Zulu: Ngokwesibonelo, iningi labantu abaphendula imibuzo yabo yenhlolovo kwakungabesifazane nabantu abavela emazweni acebile.
Hausa: Alal misali, akasarin mutanen da suka amsa tambayoyin bincikensu mata ne da kuma mutane daga ƙasashe masu arziki.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, bontši bja batho bao ba arabilego dipotšišo tša bona tša dinyakišišo e bile basadi le batho go tšw aka dinageng tše di humilego.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ የዳሰሳ ጥናት ጥያቄዎቻቸውን የመለሱት አብዛኞቹ ሰዎች ሴቶች እና የሃብታም ሃገራት ሰዎች ነበሩ።

English: Also, since the survey was online, people without proper internet access could not participate.
Luganda: Ekirala, olw’okuba okubuuza kwali ku mutimbagano, abantu abatalina mutimbagano baali tebasobola kwetabamu.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, níwọ̀n ìgbà tí ó jẹ́ pé orí ẹ̀rọ ni ìtọpinpin náà, àwọn ènìyàn tí wọn kò ní àǹfààní ẹ̀rọ̀ ayélijára tó jíire kò lè kópa.
Zulu: Futhi, njengoba inhlolovo ibiku-inthanethi, abantu abangenayo i-inthanethi efanele abakwazanga ukubamba iqhaza.
Hausa: Har ila yau, tun da binciken ya kasance na kan intanet, mutanen da ba su da hanyar intanet mai kyau ba za su iya shiga ba.
Northern Sotho: Gape, ka ge dinyakišišo di be di dirwa inthaneteng, batho bao ba bego ba hloka phihlelelo ya maleba go inthanete ba paletšwe ke go kgatha tema.
Amharic: እንዲሁም፣ የዳሰሳ ጥናቱ በመስመር ላይ ስለነበር፣ ትክክለኛ የድህረ ገጽ አገልግሎት የሌላቸው ሰዎች ሊሳተፉ አልቻሉም።

English: These researchers were from Botswana, Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, the USA, China, Singapore, Switzerland, Belgium, Czech Republic, Argentina, Panama, UK, Australia, Denmark, Italy, Malaysia, Latvia, Uruguay, and France.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano baali bava mu Botswana, Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, USA, China, Singapore, Switzerland, Belgium, Czech Republic, Argentina, Panama, UK, Australia, Denmark, Italy, Malaysia, Latvia, Uruguay, ne France.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí jẹ́ láti orílẹ̀-èdè Botswana, Egypt, Kenya, Nàìjííríà, South Africa, USA, China, Singapore, Switzerland, Belgium, Czech Republic, Argentina, Panama, UK, Australia, Denmark, Italy, Malaysia, Latvia, Uruguay, àti France.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bebevela e-Botswana, Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, USA, China, Singapore, Switzerland, Belgium, Czech Republic, Argentina, Panama, UK, Australia, Denmark, Italy, Malaysia, Latvia, Uruguay, kanye ne-France.
